notes.title: Bloopy & Droopy 1 year anniversary!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Today it's already been a year since [i]Bloopy & Droopy[/i] was released, our very first game on this platform, time goes by so fast!

[h3]Happy Birthday Bloopy & Droopy![/h3]

To celebrate it properly, we are releasing the patch 1.2! But what's new in this version?
[list]
[*] We have [b]entirely redesigned[/b] the graphics of the game to give you a better experience and for those who have already finished the game maybe the desire to try it again! A big thanks to [url=https://twitter.com/Keenan_Dev]Keenan_Dev[/url] for his amazing work!
[*] We have also arranged some of the text.
[/list]

We sincerely hope that you will have a good time on [i]Bloopy & Droopy[/i] thanks to these changes, especially in the graphics area, Have fun!

[b]- DreamVeloper Studio.[/b]

notes.title: Bloopy & Droopy Version 1.1!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

We are very happy to announce the release of the[b] Version 1.1[/b] of Bloopy & Droopy! What's new in this patch? Let's dig into this, right now!

[list]
[*] Some adjustements on certains levels, more particulary in Pluf Pluf River and Blocky City
[*] Your max lives increase from 5 to 10
[*] Captain Kurgos battle is now easier: less HP, attack speed of small ships have been lowered, more indications in phase 2 and less asteroids too. You also recover all your hearts between each phase now.
[*] Some minor bugs fixed
[*] We added a bunch of new languages: French, Spanish and Portuguese!
[/list]

We sincerely hope you'll have a great time on Bloopy & Droopy thanks to these modifications, have fun!

- [b]DreamVeloper Studio[/b].
